# Wayward Naval Forces
Temporal anomalies within the Colossus Radius sometimes cause "shades", mere echoes of what used to be people, to appear and inhabit washed up wreckages. For some reason, there appears to be a pattern of red-clothed shades winding up on planetary bases.
[bold][color=#a4885c]________________________________________________________________________[/color]

Doomed to repeat the same menial tasks evermore.
- [bold][color=#a4885c]Health thresholds:[/color][/bold] 100 (crit), 130 (death) - [bold][color=#a4885c]Run (walk) speed:[/color][/bold] 4.5 m/s (2.5 m/s)[bold][color=#a4885c]*[/color][/bold] - [bold][color=#a4885c]Damage (type):[/color][/bold] 16 [color=yellow]Piercing[/color] (.35 round) - [bold][color=#a4885c]Damage resistances:[/color][/bold] [color=red]Blunt[/color], [color=red]Slash[/color] and [color=yellow]Piercing[/color] 30%; [color=orange]Heat[/color] 20%; [color=orange]Caustic[/color] 10%; [color=yellow]Explosion[/color] 10% (armor vest) - [bold][color=#a4885c]Special abilities:[/color][/bold] Shooter (Viper)

# "saboteur"
Likely used to be trained in the art of sabotage. Equipped with EMP rounds, take caution.

# "medic"
The remains of a medical specialist, the anomaly has stripped them of any semblance of Hippocrates' oath. Uses darts laced with harmful chemicals - impedrezene or chloral hydrate.

# Mission Objectives ## Elimination
Eliminate a large and dangerous creature - a [color=#a4885c]wayward commander[/color] within given time constraints to earn a monetary reward.
## Destruction
Destroy a certain number of [color=#a4885c]data miners[/color] within given time constraints to earn a monetary reward.
